 Sooners Illustrated Staff Picks: Oklahoma at No. 24 Florida
 The Sooners Illustrated staff lock in their final score predictions for Oklahoma's Week 10 matchup vs No. 24 Florida on Saturday night in Gainesville, FL. 
 Josh Callaway 4 GAINESVILLE, FL – Back on the road to start the month of November. 
 After a heinous home loss to South Carolina that resulted in the firing of offensive coordinator Ben Arbuckle, Oklahoma (4-4, 2-3) is out east for a Saturday night showdown in "The Swamp" against No. 24 Florida (5-3, 3-3) in Gainesville, FL. Kickoff is set for 6:45 p.m. CT/7:45 p.m. ET on SEC Network with the Sooner Sports Network having the radio call. 
 On Friday's game preview show, the Sooners Illustrated staff locked in their final score predictions for the matchup. Here is a recap of their picks with the full show linked at the bottom of the page:
 Brody Lusk: 24-17 Florida 
 "I just don't know that Oklahoma is going to have it offensively. There's too much unknown for me right now."
 "I don't have enough confidence from what we're going to see from Oklahoma offensively to pick them to win this game."
 Josh Callaway: 17-16 Florida 
 "This game feels like as much of a coin flip as we've had (this season)."
 "I'm imagining Oklahoma is really conservative offensively. Run the football, get around the 30 and 'We're okay to kick a field goal' type of a vibe from them."
 "I'm just going to go with Florida makes a couple more plays…Low-scoring game. Jason Witten does some nice things but I still have a hard time imagining there's going to be a lot of explosives still."
 Tom Green: 17-14 Oklahoma 
 "I think this defense is going to come out really angry and with something to prove. Especially with Tramell Jones starting at quarterback (for Florida)."
 "You tell me an inexperienced quarterback is going against a Brent Venables defense, I'm going to take Brent Venables' defense nine times out of ten in that situation."
 "I don't expect a lot from the (Oklahoma) offense. The bar is pretty low for what the offense needs to do to look better than they have in recent weeks…I think just the fact they have a change at play-caller is going to provide a little more juice coursing through the veins for some of those guys on offense."
 "I think these guys are going to be a little juiced to play for Jason Witten."
